latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Auto Caption

- Automatically generate and add captions to video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Processes videos on cloud GPUs at 1080p; returns captioned MP4s in 30–60 seconds.
- No installation required; uses a free, temporary API token for anonymous access.
- Supports uploading, exporting, checking credits, and timeline preview.
- Handles errors (expired token, session issues, file size/type, rate limits) with clear user feedback.
- Designed for fast, automated captioning—ideal for content creators.
